span.label: whether primary and non-primary auditory cortex encode the temporal shape of the sound envelope on different time scales

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: Longer sustained responses in ventral non-primary cortex require a downstream reader to integrate over a longer time constant, which is what produces the hierarchy of optimal time scales
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: Pooling across neurons averages out the timing jitter of individual spike trains, restoring classification accuracy in temporally imprecise fields
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: Field-specific thalamocortical pathways impose a time-frequency trade-off, buying A1 its temporal resolution at the cost of spectral resolution and vice versa for non-primary fields
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: longer response durations in the ventral fields give a downstream reader more time to integrate, so the time constant that best discriminates sound shape is longer there
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: onset spikes carry most of the discrimination in every field, and what is left after they are removed is what separates the fields - the sustained spikes work better in VAF and cSRAF
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: and pooling compensates for imprecision - performance rises 2 to 3 fold over the average single neuron, with half maximal performance reached from fewer than 10 neurons
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: we CANNOT DISAMBIGUATE potential neural codes for sound burst slope versus duration AS THESE CUES COVARY IN OUR SOUNDS
span.note: what this limits: any code attributed to slope or to duration separately: WE CANNOT DISAMBIGUATE POTENTIAL NEURAL CODES FOR SOUND BURST SLOPE VERSUS DURATION AS THESE CUES COVARY IN OUR SOUNDS
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: we HOLD SPECTRAL AND SPATIAL CUES CONSTANT to examine neural coding of temporal cues in the sound envelope independently
span.note: what this limits: the scope of the temporal-coding claim: WE HOLD SPECTRAL AND SPATIAL CUES CONSTANT TO EXAMINE NEURAL CODING OF TEMPORAL CUES IN THE SOUND ENVELOPE INDEPENDENTLY
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: TWO CANDIDATE CODES THAT THIS DESIGN CANNOT SEPARATE, SAID OUT LOUD: we CANNOT DISAMBIGUATE potential neural codes for sound burst slope versus duration AS THESE CUES COVARY IN OUR SOUNDS
span.note: what this limits: distinguishing a code for the slope of the envelope from a code for the duration of the sound burst
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the spike-distance metric is biased at long time constants, and the fix is SYNTHETIC DATA - a periodic spike train with matched temporal statistics, extended to 100 s, standing in for the recording
span.note: what this limits: the spike-distance results at long time constants: AS tau APPROACHES THE TOTAL LENGTH OF THE SPIKE TRAIN (2 s), THE SPIKE DISTANCE IS BIASED AND YIELDS LARGE VALUES
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the classifier assumes response bins from different neurons are INDEPENDENT, which the paper states as a design property rather than as a fact about the brain
span.note: what this limits: the population classification figures: BY DESIGN, THE NAIVE BAYES CLASSIFIER TREATS RESPONSES BINS FROM DIFFERENT NEURONS AS IF THEY ARE INDEPENDENT
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the first 500 ms of every spike train is discarded, so every number here is about the ADAPTED STEADY-STATE segment and not about the response to a sound that has just begun
span.note: what this limits: every number in the paper, which describes the adapted response and not the onset: FOR ALL DATA ANALYSES, THE FIRST 500 ms WAS REMOVED FROM EACH SPIKE TRAIN TO RESTRICT ANALYSIS TO THE ADAPTED STEADY-STATE SEGMENTS
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: future exploration will be needed to determine whether classification is even more robust when spectral, temporal and spatial features are COMBINED, and WHEN ANIMALS ARE ATTENDING during a behavioral task, AS HAPPENS IN NATURAL SETTINGS
span.note: what this limits: the generality to combined cues: FUTURE EXPLORATION WILL BE NEEDED TO DETERMINE WHETHER NEURONAL CLASSIFICATION OF SOUND'S TEMPORAL SHAPE IS EVEN MORE ROBUST ... WHEN SPECTRAL, TEMPORAL AND SPATIAL FEATURES ARE COMBINED
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: a Bernoulli Naive Bayes classifier of McCallum and Nigam 1998, used to READ OUT THE SPIKE TRAINS from individual neurons and CATEGORIZE THE SOUND SHAPE
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the sensitivity index d-prime, a measure of behavioural discriminability, is repurposed to normalize a spike-train distance so that neural discrimination is expressed on a behavioural scale
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the functional hierarchy of successive stages with progressively larger receptive fields, carried from space into the time axis
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: an exponential-kernel spike distance, normalized by trial variance so that it reads as a sensitivity index
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: a D-prime of 1 corresponds to about 70% accuracy, WHICH IS TYPICALLY CONSIDERED A CRITICAL LIMIT FOR DISCRIMINATING A SIGNAL BEHAVIORALLY
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: a Bernoulli naive Bayes classifier reading spike trains as bit patterns, with its independence assumption declared and used deliberately
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the noise carrier varied across trials and across bursts, unfrozen
span.note: eliminates: spectral cues and repeated fine structure - THIS GUARANTEES THAT, ON AVERAGE, THE ONLY PHYSICAL CUES AVAILABLE TO EACH NEURON ARISE FROM THE TEMPORAL ENVELOPE
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: spectral and spatial cues held constant across every condition
span.note: eliminates: frequency and location differences contributing to what is read as temporal coding
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: each sound discriminated against itself
span.note: eliminates: a metric that returns a positive value for identical inputs - the diagonal of every matrix is zero
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the spike count distribution tested against a Poisson model before the rate classifier was built on it
span.note: eliminates: a rate code scored under a distribution the data do not follow
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: recording depth restricted to 400 to 650 micrometers
span.note: eliminates: differences between fields being differences between cortical layers - this is the depth corresponding to layer 4 in each field
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: discrimination
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: duration
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: slope → duration
span.note: THE TWO CANNOT BE SEPARATED IN THIS STUDY - the DESIGN form of the negative relation (Q-286/Q-287). No edge type can express it: all eight assert that a relation HOLDS. A confounding statement bounds what the paper's own results can mean, and it lives where nothing downstream will find it. PRESERVED HERE BECAUSE THE EDGE IT DEFEATED WAS WITHDRAWN. `slope --distinct-from--> duration` was retracted in Q-283 for asserting what this sentence denies; without this record the finding would have left the corpus with the edge. 'these cues COVARY in our sounds.'
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: sound classification performance → temporal imprecision
span.note: INVERSE ASSOCIATION, ordered across three cortical fields (A1 > VAF > cSRAF): the better the spike-timing classification, the LESS temporally imprecise the responses. No edge type carries polarity, so recording this as `causes` loses the sign that is the whole finding.
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: A HIERARCHY OF TIME SCALES: response durations and optimal time constants for discriminating sound envelope shape INCREASE IN RANK ORDER WITH A1 < VAF < cSRAF, so sustained spiking is more prominent and discrimination more robust in NON-PRIMARY cortex
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: AND THE RANK ORDER REVERSES WITH THE MEASURE: A1 and VAF have significantly HIGHER mean discrimination than cSRAF across all 45 pairs - CONVERSELY cSRAF is better across 30 pairwise comparisons when the sound is slower than 11 Hz. The same three fields, opposite orders, one figure apart
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: and reverses again by task: A1 AND VAF OUTPERFORM cSRAF in 10 alternative forced choice classification, where the ranking A1 > VAF > cSRAF is the INVERSE of the time-scale ranking
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: and once more by stimulus, inside the pooling analysis: the effect of pooling was GREATER ON AVERAGE IN A1 than in cSRAF, HOWEVER the benefit was GREATER IN cSRAF for two of the longest duration sound bursts - THE ADVANTAGES OF POOLING VARY WITH THE TIME SCALE OF THE SOUND
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: with the inverse relation stated as the finding rather than as a caveat: the ability to classify 10 sound shapes IS Quotation withheld, A1 > VAF > cSRAF - the field that discriminates on the longest time scale classifies worst
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: THE OPERATIONAL DEFINITION OF `ONSET SPIKE` IS A WINDOW THAT DIFFERS EIGHTFOLD BETWEEN THE FIELDS BEING COMPARED: the onset response time window is 29.6 ms for A1 and 180.7 ms for cSRAF at the slowest sound, and a single window is measured PER CONDITION AND PER REGION
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: and the paper says so plainly: onset response time windows VARY WITH SOUND BURST HALF-DURATION AND SLOPE as determined by the sound shaping filter, and are given FOR EACH SOUND BURST VARIATION AND CORTICAL FIELD
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: A TERM REDEFINED MID-PAPER, EXPLICITLY: onset spikes are a MIXTURE of stimulus-evoked and spontaneous activity, a subset is categorised as spontaneous BY RANDOM SAMPLING against a Poisson criterion, and IN THE REMAINDER OF THIS MANUSCRIPT WE USE THE TERM ONSET SPIKES TO DENOTE THE EVOKED ONSET SPIKES ONLY
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: SYNTHETIC DATA INSIDE THE MEASUREMENT CHAIN, DECLARED: as the time constant approaches the length of the spike train THE SPIKE DISTANCE IS BIASED, so the spike train was EXTENDED BY SYNTHESIZING a periodic spike train WITH MATCHED TEMPORAL STATISTICS, sampling rate and times from the original, out to 100 s
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: TWO CANDIDATE CODES THIS DESIGN CANNOT SEPARATE: we CANNOT DISAMBIGUATE potential neural codes for sound burst slope versus duration AS THESE CUES COVARY IN OUR SOUNDS - and the untestable possibility is still stated, that non-primary cortices are more sensitive to duration
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: an imported threshold that gives the index its meaning: a D-prime of 1 corresponds to about 70% accuracy, WHICH IS TYPICALLY CONSIDERED A CRITICAL LIMIT for discriminating a signal behaviorally - a behavioral criterion borrowed to read a number computed from spikes
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: an assumption declared and then used as a feature: the naive Bayes classifier TREATS RESPONSE BINS FROM DIFFERENT NEURONS AS IF THEY ARE INDEPENDENT, which ALLOWS THE CLASSIFIER TO TAKE ADVANTAGE OF any independent and nonredundant responses
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: and a scope restriction that is easy to miss: THE FIRST 500 ms WAS REMOVED FROM EACH SPIKE TRAIN to restrict analysis to the ADAPTED STEADY-STATE segments
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: THE PARAMETER IS THE FINDING: the exponential time constant DETERMINES THE TEMPORAL RESOLUTION OR INTEGRATION TIME of the metric, large values leave mostly slow fluctuations in spike rate and small values make it sensitive to precise timing - the range tested is what lets one number stand for two rival codes
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: SPIKE RATE IS NEAR CHANCE AND SAID TO BE SO: all three fields classify with LOW PERFORMANCE ACCURACY based on spike rate alone, and spike count per 2 s IS NOT AN OPTIMAL NEURAL SIGNAL for coding sound shape
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: and pooling does not rescue it - pooled spike-rate classification is CLOSE TO CHANCE LEVELS in all cortical fields, while the timing-based classifier reaches 80 to 100%
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: with the number of neurons needed stated per field: HALF MAXIMAL PERFORMANCE from fewer than 10 neurons everywhere, but A1 and VAF require 3 and 5 against 16 for cSRAF
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: and a resolution limit read off the point where performance drops - a HALF-RESOLUTION LIMIT ON THE ORDER OF 20 ms
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: THE HIERARCHY IS CLAIMED AS DIRECTIONAL: non-primary cortex COULD CERTAINLY POOL RESPONSES FROM A1 to classify sounds BUT THE REVERSE IS LESS LIKELY, and structures reading cSRAF would need longer integration times than structures reading A1
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: A CONCEPT MOVED FROM SPACE TO TIME, AGAIN: functional hierarchies IN THE VISUAL CORTICES support the concept that classifying objects requires successive stages with a PROGRESSIVE INCREASE IN RECEPTIVE FIELD SIZE, and this study supports the idea that A SIMILAR PROGRESSION EXISTS IN AUDITORY CORTICES IN THE TIME DOMAIN
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: and the specialisation is framed as a trade-off rather than a ranking: A1 has SUPERIOR TEMPORAL RESOLUTION AT THE EXPENSE OF SPECTRAL RESOLUTION, and the non-primary fields the reverse
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: claim_type: existence
span.note: a second reading reaching the same value. Recorded: existence — a second reading reaching the same value from a different sentence. Not applied - a person decides.
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: method: sweep an exponential smoothing time constant from 1 to 256 ms, take the value that maximises a normalised spike-distance discrimination index, and read the same spike trains with a naive Bayes classifier in a 10-alternative task
span.note: a second reading DIFFERING from the recorded value. Recorded: electrophysiology — a second reading, verbatim-verified, disagreeing with the value on the record. Not applied - a person decides.
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: phenomenon: temporally precise spiking that follows the rise, fall and duration of the sound envelope rather than its spectrum
span.note: a second reading DIFFERING from the recorded value. Recorded: temporal coding of sound envelope shape across auditory cortical fields — a second reading, verbatim-verified, disagreeing with the value on the record. Not applied - a person decides.
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: qualifies → its own hierarchy claim, which holds for time constants and durations but reverses for discrimination and for classification
span.note: differs in: THE AXIS IS WHICH COMPARISON SET, AND THE ORDERING REVERSES BETWEEN THEM. 'A1 AND VAF HAVE SIGNIFICANTLY HIGHER MEAN DISCRIMINATION THAN CSRAF averaged across all 45 pairwise discriminations. CONVERSELY, CSRAF NEURONS ARE MARGINALLY BETTER AT DISCRIMINATING across 30 pairwise sound comparisons [at low rates].' The same three fields rank one way over one set of comparisons and the other way over a subset - so a hierarchy claim is a claim about the averaging window, and this record's [32] gives the time-constant ordering that does hold. Q-507.

span.label: RETRACTED (RELATIONAL, AND INVERSE - `causes` can express neither) · classification —causes→ imprecision
span.note: RETRACTED: RELATIONAL, AND INVERSE - `causes` can express neither. The span says the ability to classify sound shapes is Quotation withheld, with the ordering A1 > VAF > cSRAF. An inverse relation is not a cause, and the schema has no polarity at all, so the direction of the association cannot be recorded on an edge even when the relation itself is right. WHAT THE SPAN DOES SAY (Q-309): an inverse association with an ordering across three fields, housed as an unhoused row. — strength of the relation: 1 — stated as the finding, not as a caveat - the ability to classify 10 sound shapes is INVERSELY RELATED to temporal imprecision, A1 > VAF > cSRAF, so the field with the longest time scale classifies worst
